overall_validity.rationale: All configured variables are instantiated in a manner tightly aligned with their definitions: the agent prepares a full draft return under moderately conservative client preferences and firm policies, with complex but not maximal internal constraints, primary-source guidance only, and nearly complete documentation with minor gaps. World-update rules are followed: tax-law guidance changes arrive in several rounds (notice, instructions, FAQ) without unrelated shocks; resources start near-complete and are incrementally supplemented; actors communicate in precise, businesslike messages focused on documents and treatment decisions; and consequences emphasize internal evaluation, especially penalizing overclaiming while tolerating conservative positions. Rendering instructions are respected: each round includes consequence, context/resource/actor updates, and an antecedent; no extraneous confounds or meta-commentary are introduced; events (uploads, confirmations, reviewer notes) concretely realize the abstract variable settings; update frequency and narrative continuity are consistent across rounds. Any imperfections (e.g., the agent’s internal limitations about actually viewing documents) concern the agent’s behavior rather than the environment design and do not materially distort the intended configuration or the causal structure being tested. Thus, any issues are peripheral, and the simulation provides a clean, high-fidelity test bed for the specified conditions.
